title: EcopathIMTA: data and R code for Ecopath models of seawater and freshwater integrated multi-trophic aquaculture
description:
Processed input data and R code supporting the article Trophic structure and plant-based feed substitution in integrated multi-trophic aquaculture: An Ecopath modeling approach. The code builds Rpath mass-balance models of a seawater (mud crab, red algae) and a freshwater (sea bass, tilapia, duckweed) IMTA system in Taiwan (2024), runs red algae and duckweed feed-substitution gradient scenarios, computes ecosystem indices and avoided feed emissions, and propagates pedigree-based parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo. It reproduces Tables 1-5, S1-S3 and S5 and Figures 1-3 and S2 of the article.

Code: MIT License. Data (data/): CC BY 4.0. The raw field records of the Fisheries Research Institute, Taiwan, are not included.
